topic: 限时阅读：判断题与证据范围
grammarFocus: 否定、比较、数量范围和时态；限定词的含义。
title: Timed Reading and the Boundaries of Evidence: Judging Claims Under Pressure
prompt: In many university courses, students are now asked to complete timed reading tasks in which they must decide whether statements are supported by a passage, contradicted by it, or simply not addressed. Some educators argue that this trains learners to judge the exact boundaries of evidence, while others believe the time limit rewards quick guessing rather than genuine understanding. To what extent do you agree or disagree that timed true/false/not-given reading tasks develop useful academic judgement? Write at least 250 words. In your essay, state your position clearly, discuss both the claimed benefits and the weaknesses of such tasks, and give reasons and examples from your own experience or observation to support your view.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先仔细阅读 prompt 中的完整题目，确认题目要求你回答的是“在多大程度上同意或不同意限时判断题能培养学术判断力”，而不是泛泛讨论阅读速度。写作时须明确表明立场，并同时讨论该题型的所谓益处与不足，用你自己的经验或观察举例支持。注意题目中的“not given”类判断强调证据边界：你的论证也应区分“有证据支持”“证据相反”和“证据不足”，避免把猜测当作结论。全文不少于250词，建议用清晰段落展开：引言表明立场，主体段分别处理支持与反对的理由并举例，结论重申观点。不要背诵模板或虚构官方统计数字。
